result.rationale: Exclude the company, not only I Squared's ownership period. Epirus makes defense-focused high-power-microwave, counter-UAS and power-electronics systems; it does not own or operate infrastructure. I Squared expressly calls InfraTech a venture strategy for growth-stage technology companies. No qualifying direct-infrastructure mandate or alternate qualifying owner was found.

owners.transactionState: CLOSED_SERIES_C_EQUITY; exact class and 2025 follow-on participation UNRESOLVED; Active on manager site; no verified exit

ownershipResolution.security: The Form D records an equity offering with first sale 2022-01-28; I Squared's exact share class, allocation and percentage are not public.
ownershipResolution.otherRelevantInvestors: T. Rowe Price led Series C and returned in Series D; StepStone joined both; 8VC and Washington Harbour led Series D; General Dynamics Land Systems was strategic. No named investor was tied to a qualifying infrastructure mandate for Epirus.
ownershipResolution.status: I Squared lists Epirus Active under InfraTech. Its omission from the Series D release does not prove exit; follow-on participation/dilution remains UNRESOLVED.

operatingResolution.model: Designs, engineers, manufactures and contract-delivers software-defined HPM/counter-UAS systems and advanced electronics through prototype, OTA, IDIQ and as-a-service arrangements.
operatingResolution.customers: U.S. DoD, allied/government buyers and defense partners; commercial uses are secondary.
operatingResolution.footprint: Torrance headquarters/R&D/manufacturing-test capability plus Oklahoma office/simulation/test presence; property ownership is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
operatingResolution.infrastructureTest: FAIL: corporate/manufacturing/R&D sites and products are not an owned utility, transport, digital, environmental or social-infrastructure platform.

acquisitionExitCheck.companyOutcome: No IPO, acquisition or control sale found.
